item.title: Civilians in Taunggyi Targeted for Portering and Forced Military Service
item.description: Residents of Taunggyi, southern Shan State, say regime troops are lying in wait in secluded areas of the city to forcibly seize civilians, including women, for portering and military service, heightening fear among local communities.
